purpose: Exploratory model sufficiency on the inspected six-object regression set; not a final forecast test
coverage_note: First bounded matrix: all six objects, one predeclared start crossing Apophis encounter, five horizons; expansion to 2026-2028 is a separate experiment

earth_j2.constant_source: Stored Horizons Earth header (IERS 2010 J2); JPL planetary physical parameters equatorial radius
earth_j2.limitation: Mean-pole text-PCK approximation; no nutation or EOP and not exact Horizons force/rotation matching

protocol.reference: Stored immutable Horizons snapshot; conditional propagation from a supplied initial state
protocol.primary_error: max sampled position error; daily backbone with the predeclared Apophis refined window when present
protocol.fitted_non_gravitational_parameters: excluded from primary candidates; retained only in separate J2 teacher-matching audit
protocol.timing: Warm resident ephemerides; cumulative prefix runtime through each horizon, including force construction, integration, interpolation and output instrumentation; shared loading reported separately
protocol.oracle: Offline label-aware lower-cost reference within candidates, not a deployable selector; no formal error guarantee
protocol.numerical_quality: Observed production-versus-halved-step trajectory difference, not a rigorous error bound
protocol.encounter_grid: Fixed existing Apophis window is a benchmark output schedule, not an inferred forecast-time encounter feature
